paper_metadata.title: High-Temperature Strength of Ir-based Refractory Superalloys
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of the Japan Institute of Metals

evidence.quote: Refractory superalloys are defined as alloys that have an fcc and L12 two-phase coherent structure and yet considerably high melting points.
This paper examines compressive strength up to 1800℃ and creep behavior at 1500℃ of Ir-V, -Ti, -Nb, -Ta, -Hf, and -Zr binary refractory superalloys.
